name: Node Edit Access by Term
description: Restricts node EDIT access by taxonomy term (terms carry allowed user/role fields). SECURITY: the restriction is enforced only in hook_form_alter (throws AccessDeniedHttpException on the edit form) with NO hook_node_access — so it is bypassed by JSON:API/REST PATCH, Quick Edit, Views Bulk Operations, and programmatic edits. Treat it as a UI hint, not an access control, until it implements hook_node_access.
